_comment: AB10-T1: alert rules the server evaluates itself, every minute, on the built-in metrics store (ops_metric_sample) when no Prometheus runs. Kinds: threshold (the latest minute's value, aggregated over the matching series), increase (a counter's rise over the window), ratio (one increase over another) and stale (a series, grouped by a label, that stopped reporting). A match value ending in * is a prefix. observability/alerts.yml stays the Prometheus definition of the same signals.

rules.name: HighHttpErrorRate
rules.summary: More than 2% of requests failed with a 5xx status over 5 minutes

rules.name: DbPoolAcquireTimeouts
rules.summary: Requests timed out waiting for a database connection

rules.name: JobsInDeadLetter
rules.summary: Background jobs failed for good and wait in the dead-letter queue

rules.name: JobBacklogOld
rules.summary: The oldest waiting background job has waited more than 15 minutes

rules.name: AuditChainerLag
rules.summary: Audit events wait more than 5 minutes to be sealed into the chain

rules.name: ObjectStorageDown
rules.summary: The file store does not answer

rules.name: ChangesPaused
rules.summary: The deployment is read-only: changes are paused

rules.name: NodeStoppedReporting
rules.summary: A server node stopped sending its heartbeat

rules.name: ChangeFeedConsumerLagging
rules.summary: A change-feed consumer is more than 5 minutes behind

rules.name: FileIntegrityFailures
rules.summary: Stored files differ from what was uploaded, or are missing
